verdict.line: You lose if you let his Q hook convert into a W all-in before level 6; you win by surviving to your E/R spike and grinding down Skaarl's health bar.

brief.thesis: The lane itself is genuinely even — Kled's advantage isn't lane pressure, it's the solo-kill tools: Q (Bear Trap on a Rope) hooks and yanks you from 800 range, then W (Violent Tendencies) gives him a four-hit attack-speed burst to finish the all-in. Gwen's kit doesn't contest his engage range, so the matchup is won by surviving those windows, chunking Skaarl's health bar with Q (Snip Snip!) snips, and punishing the dismounted Kled once his passive makes him deal less damage to champions. The 56.9% win rate over 51 games reflects Gwen's mid-to-late trading pattern outscaling his early aggression, not an early-lane edge.

theirWindow.when: Kled's Q hook lands and yanks you
theirWindow.what: He follows immediately with W's attack-speed burst to all-in. Disengage with E (Skip 'n Slash, 400 range) the instant you're yanked, or only stand and trade if E is already up to extend and punish.

yourWindow.when: Skaarl's health bar breaks, Kled dismounts
yourWindow.what: A dismounted Kled deals less damage to champions per his passive and loses Q for the ranged Pocket Pistol. Commit with Q snips and R (Needlework) before he can rebuild courage and remount.

runes.keystoneWhy: The most commonly run page (33.9% pick); Conqueror stacks off the sustained melee trading Gwen's Q snips and E on-hit extensions create, which matches how you actually win this lane — grinding, not bursting.

summoners.why: The dominant pick in this matchup (67.3% pick, 51.4% WR); Ignite offsets Kled's innate solo-kill edge by letting you finish him before he can disengage with E (Jousting) or stall out the fight.

playing.title: Track Skaarl's health bar
playing.detail: Watch the mount HP, not just Kled's. Once it nears empty he's about to dismount and deal less damage to champions per his passive — that's your green light to commit the full combo.

playing.title: Respect the 800-range hook
playing.detail: Kled's Q (Bear Trap on a Rope) hooks and yanks from 800 range on an 11-7s cooldown. Don't stand at that range without E (Skip 'n Slash, 400 range) ready to answer.

playing.title: Trade after his second Joust
playing.detail: E (Jousting, 550 range, 13-9s cd) can be recast to dash back through you. Once both casts are spent his gap-close is down — that's when your E window lets you stick and punish with empowered autos.

playing.title: Save W for his commit, not his poke
playing.detail: Hallowed Mist (22-18s cd) only matters once he's actually in melee range. Hold it for when his W (Violent Tendencies) attack-speed burst is live, not for chip damage.

playing.title: Snip through Skaarl, not around him
playing.detail: Q (Snip Snip!) can hit up to 6 times with true damage in the center — stack snips early to speed up the dismount instead of trading passively.

playing.title: Needlework the dismounted retreat
playing.detail: Once Skaarl's bar breaks, Kled's kit swaps to the ranged Pocket Pistol and his damage drops. Throw R (Needlework, 1200 range, up to 3 casts) to slow and finish instead of chasing into Joust range.

playing.title: Play for the back half of lane
playing.detail: The lane is even through roughly level 6 — the measured 56.9% win rate over 51 games comes from the midgame spike. Don't force all-ins before both E and R are ranked up.

brief.patchCaveat: The build, runes, and the 56.9% win rate over 51 games are measured from current-patch games on OP.GG; the mechanical reasoning — why these choices work turn-by-turn — is my own read of the kit.
